data.name: caption_text
data.value: Try the complete workflow in an open document or an official Autodesk sample.

data.name: startWithOpenDocument_text
data.value: When you finish, the diagnostic panels will open and the tour will start in the current document.

data.name: prepareSample_text
data.value: When you finish, a disposable copy of the selected Autodesk sample will open in this Revit instance. The required panels will appear with the document.

data.name: waitForDocument_text
data.value: When you finish, the tour will wait for a project or family and then show the required panels.

data.name: skipTour_text
data.value: The practical tour will not start. You can return to it later from Getting started.

data.name: openDocumentHint_text
data.value: The current document will be used for the practical tour.

data.name: tutorialSampleHint_text
data.value: Choose a found Autodesk sample, or clear the option to open your own document.

data.name: tutorialSampleUnavailable_text
data.value: No compatible Autodesk sample was found. You can continue with a document you open yourself.

data.name: tutorialSampleFailed_text
data.value: The tutorial copy could not be prepared. Continue by opening a project or family yourself.

data.name: startPracticalTour_text
data.value: Start or continue the practical tour
